title.en: Take-profit and stop-loss are plans, not insurance
title.zh-Hans: 止盈止损，是计划，不是保险

shots.visual_en: After setting a stop-loss, Sam draws an 'ABSOLUTELY SAFE' force field around the account.
shots.visual_zh: 小白设置止损后，给账户画上一圈“绝对安全”的防护罩。

text.en: My stop-loss is set, so I can only lose the amount I typed, right?
text.zh-Hans: 止损已经设好，所以一定只亏我填的金额？

shots.source_visual_zh: 小白设置止损后，给账户画上一圈“绝对安全”的防护罩。

shots.visual_en: The force field turns into an 'Action plan' card with three steps: trigger price, order submitted, actual fill.
shots.visual_zh: 防护罩改成“行动计划”卡，触发价、提交订单、实际成交分三步。

text.en: A stop-loss runs your exit plan when a condition is met. It's not insurance. Being triggered doesn't mean you'll fill at that price, and it doesn't guarantee the loss stops exactly there.
text.zh-Hans: 止损是条件达到时执行退出计划，不是保险。触发了条件，不等于一定按那个价格成交，也不保证损失刚好停在那里。

shots.source_visual_zh: 防护罩改成“行动计划”卡，触发价、提交订单、实际成交分三步。

shots.visual_en: Price drops to the trigger line; the stop-market path goes straight into the order book; the average fill drifts slightly.
shots.visual_zh: 价格跌到触发线，止损市价路径直接进入对手盘，成交均价稍有偏移。
shots.onscreen_text_zh-Hans: 止损市价：尽快离场，可能滑点

text.en: After the trigger, a stop-market order exits at market. It prioritises getting out fast, but the price can slip. In fast or thin markets, the gap can be bigger.
text.zh-Hans: 触发后按市价执行，重视尽快离场，但实际价格可能有滑点。行情很快或深度不足时，差异可能更大。

shots.source_visual_zh: 价格跌到触发线，止损市价路径直接进入对手盘，成交均价稍有偏移。

zh-Hans: 止损市价：尽快离场，可能滑点

shots.visual_en: Stop-limit path posts a limit order; the price gaps through the limit; the order still shows Unfilled.
shots.visual_zh: 止损限价路径挂出委托，价格快速越过限制，订单仍显示未成交。
shots.onscreen_text_en: Stop-limit: price capped, may not fill
shots.onscreen_text_zh-Hans: 止损限价：限价，可能不成交

text.en: A stop-limit posts a limit order after the trigger. It caps the price you'll accept, but if the price races past, it may not sell at all. Neither one is always better. They're different trade-offs.
text.zh-Hans: 触发后挂限价，能限制接受的成交价格，却可能因为价格快速穿过而卖不掉。两种方式不是谁永远更好，而是不同取舍。

shots.source_visual_zh: 止损限价路径挂出委托，价格快速越过限制，订单仍显示未成交。

en: Stop-limit: price capped, may not fill
zh-Hans: 止损限价：限价，可能不成交

shots.visual_en: Take-profit line, stop-loss line and remaining position side by side; a corner note for futures: 'Check the trigger price type'.
shots.visual_zh: 止盈线、止损线和剩余持仓并排；合约角落提示核对触发价格类型。

text.en: After setting them, check the direction, quantity and order status. For futures, also check which price triggers it, so your stop isn't placed where liquidation could come first.
text.zh-Hans: 设置后检查方向、数量和订单状态。合约还要核对用哪种价格触发，避免把止损线放在可能先被强平的位置。

shots.source_visual_zh: 止盈线、止损线和剩余持仓并排；合约角落提示核对触发价格类型。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Once a stop-limit is triggered, is it guaranteed to fill?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：价格触发止损限价后，是否保证成交？

text.en: Know its limits, and a stop-loss becomes a real plan, not a lucky charm.
text.zh-Hans: 明白限制，才能把止损当成有效计划，而不是护身符。

question.en: Once a stop-limit is triggered, is it guaranteed to fill?
question.zh-Hans: 止损限价单触发后，一定成交吗？

shots.source_visual_zh: 题目：价格触发止损限价后，是否保证成交？

zh-Hans: 止损限价触发 = 成交？ 不保证

text.en: Both say BTC. But one may not give you any bitcoin at all. Next: spot vs futures.

goal.en: Understand trigger vs fill, and the different risks of stop-market and stop-limit orders.
goal.zh-Hans: 理解触发与成交的区别，能识别止损市价和止损限价的不同风险。

page_cta.line_en: Compare stop-market and stop-limit in the same sharp drop in the practice panel below.
page_cta.line_zh: 在下方练习面板里，用同一段急跌对比止损市价和止损限价。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Compare the practice results of a stop-market and a stop-limit order in the same sharp drop.
exercise.task_zh: 对比同一段急跌中止损市价和止损限价的模拟结果。
exercise.answer_en: The first may slip; the second may not fill. Neither is capital-protection insurance.
exercise.answer_zh: 前者可能滑点，后者可能不成交；二者都不是保本保险。
